name: calendar_app_lookup_name

ownership.argument: Borrowed bounded NUL-terminated exact package/app name; active registry and selected hash bucket must be initialized and validated before invocation.
ownership.return_value: Borrowed manager-owned active app record or NULL on miss. Package +8 and icon pathname +12 are replaced/freed by native update/removal; copy synchronously on the serialized UI owner and retain no native pointers.

provenance.source: Exact .043 AP instruction/call-site audit for calendar and QuickApp active-name lookup; see module targets/xiaomi-band-10-pro-3.101.043/calendar-reload.md, quickapp-icons.md and tests/firmware_quickapp_icon.py. Reuses the existing exact callable, no duplicate alias, SDK promotion or range expansion.

notes: Legacy calendar symbol name retained: this entry is the generic read-only active-name lookup, not a snapshot generator or launcher mutation. Service *0x200eb658 must equal 0x2cdbb054, slot +12 must equal 0xca69e81, active registry *0x200eb650 and its selected bucket must be guarded; never use the uninstalled/recoverable map at 0x200eb654 as fallback. Serialized miwear/UI-owner timer only, outside IRQ/manager locks. The valid AP path does not allocate, lock or mutate the registry; blocking metadata remains conservative because comparison veneer 0xcac0a48 targets absent ROM 0x00276854. No hardware context/liveness/GPU acceptance; restricted/PENDING retained.
